captured_cases.expected_outcome: The exact parked run remains immutable evidence of the undeclared-reference wedge.
The same page and payload open with an explicit reason; benchmark cells terminate visibly without reader dispatch and all other lenses proceed.

atomic_step.outcome: Open requires a frozen reference id and page or a recorded no-reference reason; no-reference benchmark cells are terminal, visible, never read, and documented as not applicable.
atomic_step.practical_value: A missing real benchmark can no longer wedge a live critique or be disguised as a clear judgment.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: The frozen red run is unchanged; the same page and payload pass the no-reference operator path beyond unit one; declared-reference behavior remains intact; both managed client installs match the canonical correction.

final_validation.failure_criterion: Any benchmark cell is judged, any applicable cell is unreachable, or the document omits the reason.
final_validation.operator_path: Open the unchanged BTM page with the recorded no-reference reason, replay only prior real nonbenchmark seat records, resolve prior real owner rulings, and produce the public findings document.
final_validation.success_criterion: The red bytes remain unchanged and the new run completes with 150 judged plus 25 visible not-applicable cells.

approaches.hypothesis: Freezing applicability at open prevents an absent benchmark from ever reaching a seat.
approaches.implementation: Require the benchmark-source choice at open and pre-record no-reference benchmark cells as terminal not-applicable state.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: One explicit opening argument in exchange for immutable applicability and no reader wedge.

approaches.hypothesis: A late read-run check can bypass benchmark cells without changing the opening contract.
approaches.implementation: Allow an undeclared open and decide whether to bypass benchmark cells only when read-run starts.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Fewer opening arguments, but the reason arrives after readers may have run and existing state must be rewritten.

mini_probes.goal: Prevent an absent benchmark from reaching a reader while preserving it as visible state.
mini_probes.practical_value: A missing real benchmark can no longer wedge a live critique or be disguised as a clear judgment.

proof.failure_criterion: Applicability is decided after opening, a benchmark cell reaches a seat, the reason is hidden, or an existing run is rewritten.
proof.success_criterion: The reason is frozen at open, all 25 benchmark cells are terminal and visible, no benchmark seat record exists, and the existing red run remains byte-identical.

winner_output.description: Open-time declaration plus visible terminal no-reference cells.

mini_probes.work_type_reason: The immutable run contract and reader dispatch gate are executable code boundaries.
